_설명: AI 도트 밑그림 캡션 (FLUX 3 Image Klein 빠른판, 4-29). 앞: intro_front + 자세 + NOT + WEAP + 생김새 + style_front/back + background(배경색). 뒤: intro_back + 자세 + NOT + WEAP_back + 생김새(back) + style. 참고 그림 = 캐릭터 작은 그림(input/bseo/ref/c00/<slug>_00s.png) + 마네킹(input/bseo/ref/pose_r<f|b>_<a~e>.png). 생김새 글은 Claude 가 팬키트 기본 전신 그림을 보고 쓴 것
intro_front: Create a pixel art battle sprite of the character from the first image.
intro_back: Create a pixel art battle sprite of the character from the first image seen from behind.
style_front: Render as a retro handheld RPG pixel art battle sprite of a trainer that matches the pixel grid, size and framing of the pixel-art mannequin in the second image: an 80 by 80 pixel sprite enlarged twelve times with nearest-neighbor scaling so every pixel is a crisp 12 by 12 square, the whole figure about 74 pixels tall, slightly stylized proportions about five heads tall with a large head and a clearly readable face: two distinct dark eyes with a one-pixel white highlight, eyebrows and a small mouth showing the character's expression, a one-pixel pure black outline around the outer silhouette and darker-shade one-pixel lines between inner shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per color, about fifteen colors in total, light from the upper left, no anti-aliasing, no dithering, no gradients, no blur, no text, no ground shadow.
style_back: Render as a retro handheld RPG pixel art battle sprite of a trainer seen from behind that matches the pixel grid, size and framing of the pixel-art mannequin in the second image: an 80 by 120 pixel sprite enlarged ten times with nearest-neighbor scaling so every pixel is a crisp 10 by 10 square, the figure from the top of the head down to the thighs about 115 pixels tall and cut off by the bottom edge, a large head turned to the side so the profile shows one clearly drawn eye, eyebrow and mouth, a one-pixel pure black outline around the outer silhouette and darker-shade one-pixel lines between inner shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per color, about fifteen colors in total, light from the upper left, no anti-aliasing, no dithering, no gradients, no blur, no text, no ground shadow.

background.green: Centered on a plain flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background.
background.magenta: Centered on a plain flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background.

pose_image: bseo/ref/pdot/<f|b>_<a~e>_<green|magenta>.png  (마네킹 도트: 앞 80×80 ×12 · 뒤 80×120 ×10, clean_dot 으로 만든 것)
not_pose: Do not use the pose of the first image; take only the character's appearance from the first image, and do not copy the mannequin's gray color, joints or blank face.
weapon_front: If the character carries a weapon, hold it in the raised hand or rest it on the shoulder.
weapon_back: If the character carries a weapon, keep it visible in hand, on the shoulder or on the back.

poses.fa: Use the pose of the gray mannequin in the second image: the whole figure standing from head to feet, feet planted wide apart in an A-shape, the body facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle toward frame-left, one hand raised beside the shoulder at head height, the other arm hanging slightly back with the hand near the thigh, the head facing the viewer with a slight tilt.
poses.fb: Use the pose of the gray mannequin in the second image: the whole figure standing from head to feet, the weight on one straight leg and the other knee bent inward, the hips cocked to one side, one hand resting on the hip, the other hand raised to the cheek, the body twisted slightly toward frame-left and the head facing the viewer.
poses.fc: Use the pose of the gray mannequin in the second image: the whole figure standing from head to feet, feet planted apart, the body facing the viewer with the shoulders twisted slightly toward frame-left, the near arm raised and stretched out toward frame-left at head height as if about to throw, the other hand resting on the hip with the elbow pointing out, the head turned toward frame-left.
poses.fd: Use the pose of the gray mannequin in the second image: the whole figure standing from head to feet, feet planted apart, the body facing the viewer with a slight twist, one hand resting on the hip on the frame-left side with the elbow pointing out, the other arm stretched straight out and down toward frame-right with the palm open, the head facing the viewer.
poses.fe: Use the pose of the gray mannequin in the second image: the whole figure standing from head to feet in a wide stride, the body turned almost sideways toward frame-left, the front arm stretched straight out toward frame-left at shoulder height, the back arm bent with the hand near the chest, the head in profile looking toward frame-left.
poses.ba: Use the pose and framing of the gray mannequin in the second image: seen from behind and to the side, the body turned almost sideways toward the right so the back, the near shoulder and the side of the chest show, the head in profile looking right at an opponent, the near arm hanging down with the hand by the thigh, framed from the top of the head down to the upper thighs so the legs are cut off by the bottom edge. Show the back of the hair, the back of the outfit and anything carried on the back.
poses.bb: Use the pose and framing of the gray mannequin in the second image: seen from behind with the back toward the viewer, the body turned slightly to the right, the head turned to the right so only a little of the cheek shows, one arm hanging at the side and the other bent with the hand at the hip, framed from the top of the head down to the upper thighs so the legs are cut off by the bottom edge. Show the back of the hair, the back of the outfit and anything carried on the back.
poses.bc: Use the pose and framing of the gray mannequin in the second image: seen from behind in a three-quarter back view with the body turned toward the right, the head turned to the right in profile, both arms hanging relaxed at the sides, framed from the top of the head down to the upper thighs so the legs are cut off by the bottom edge. Show the back of the hair, the back of the outfit and anything carried on the back.
poses.bd: Use the pose and framing of the gray mannequin in the second image: seen from behind and to the side with the body turned toward the right so the back and the near shoulder show, the head in profile looking right, the near arm hanging straight down with the hand loosely by the thigh, framed from the top of the head down to the upper thighs so the legs are cut off by the bottom edge. Show the back of the hair, the back of the outfit and anything carried on the back.
poses.be: Use the pose and framing of the gray mannequin in the second image: seen from behind and to the side with the body turned toward the right, the head in profile looking right, the near arm stretched forward toward the right at chest height as if holding something out toward the opponent, framed from the top of the head down to the upper thighs so the legs are cut off by the bottom edge. Show the back of the hair, the back of the outfit and anything carried on the back.
